title: (Locally) Associated Subrings in Polynomial and Power Series Extensions
summary: The associated, ideal-preserving, and locally associated properties of subrings, first formally defined in 2024, give a way of understanding the multiplicative structure of a subring given information about the larger ring. In this paper, we establish notation and preliminary results on a generalized type of polynomial and power series rings that is often used in the construction of counterexamples in the field of commutative algebra.
